format.brands: BRAND -> 'entry;entry;...' (one string per brand keeps the file small and is parsed only when the brand is looked up)
format.entry: 'strength,m,p,fv,s,x': strength is the number as in the product name ('' = no number in the name); one entry per strength, extra words, dosage form and release type; s and x may be left out
format.fv: form * 4 + release type; form index into forms (0 = unknown), release type index into variants (0 = plain)
format.m: MRP of one pack in paise (the pack with the lowest MRP per unit)
format.p: index into packs (the pack label as the product list prints it)
format.s: index + 1 into salts (salt composition), 0 or left out when unknown or the products disagree
format.x: index + 1 into extras (words after the brand, 'H' in 'Telma H 40'), 0 or left out when none
